status: research and implementation handoff; no RTL, loader simulation or PPA acceptance claimed

ownership.new_engine_variant: root; independent directory, same frozen core/codec/transport dependencies
ownership.frozen_candidates: Do not edit any existing engine/core/vendor/production source

topology.port0: Platform-loader model replaces the CPU at existing CPU/DMA merger port0; it is not an added third master.
topology.port1: One existing engine DMA master, including its input reads and output writes.
topology.merger: Exact frozen qingyu_icb_merge RTL, NP=2, OUTSTANDING=4, fair round robin; no vendor edits.
topology.baseline_one_per_port: 2'b01: retains current integration's one outstanding CPU-side limit.
topology.optional_queued_loader_one_per_port: 2'b00 only as a separately labelled conditional loader-source capability experiment; never report as current E203 behavior.
topology.downstream: Original e203_subsys_mems with FIFO_DP=2/CUT_READY=1/SPLT_OUTS=1/CUT_READY=1, then frozen opt33 shared wrapper.
topology.warning: The original bare dual-engine TB directly connects engine to memfab and has no existing unused CPU port; explicitly instantiate the frozen merger in the new fixture.

proposed_engine_port_additions.loader_committed_end: input [31:0], aligned exclusive byte end of the contiguous source prefix whose producer-originating successful write responses have handshaken; starts at start_source, monotonically increases within this epoch.
proposed_engine_port_additions.loader_fault: input, producer sticky error; when task is active (or accepted START with error already high), enter the existing finite error/transport-drain path and suppress successful completion. This input is metadata only, never input data.

producer.layout: Existing frozen Q8R1 packet: 202-word fixed prefix, X encoded stream, W groups0..7 encoded streams; all word-aligned.
producer.ordering: Exactly increasing source word addresses, each exactly once with full4-byte mask. No source rewrites during the task, holes, or output writes by producer.
producer.offer: Supply next packet word whenever source credits permit, retain valid/address/data/mask while not ready; no programmed bubbles in ideal mode. 'One word per cycle offered' does not imply one word per cycle accepted.
producer.commit: Advance contiguous watermark only on a matching successful originating loader response. Command acceptance alone is insufficient. Track in-order owner/address even if commands are pipelined. On response error do not advance past the failed word.
producer.early_start: Accept engine START only after at least the first202 words have successful producer ACKs. Their prefix contains every bias/shift, so later metadata reads below the suffix watermark are safe.
producer.fault: Stop new producer work, retain any already offered command, drain all accepted responses; remain in failed epoch until both producer and consumer transports are quiescent.
producer.end: Producer is complete only after exact I successful source-word responses; success also requires all I engine source reads and final output marker ACK.

descriptor_gate.placement: Between engine read-descriptor construction and qingyu_icb_stream_prefix descriptor acceptance; not at shared slave, not after memfab, not a mask over an already offered DMA command.
descriptor_gate.availability: Use 35-bit extended end = zero_extend(rd_desc_base) + (zero_extend(rd_desc_count)<<2). Available iff base>=source_base and end<=zero_extend(loader_committed_end), with alignment/range validation retained.
descriptor_gate.handshake: transport.rd_desc_valid = engine_raw_valid && available; engine.rd_desc_ready = transport_raw_ready && available. Read descriptor payload and identity remain stable while blocked. Write descriptors/words are completely independent of this gate.
descriptor_gate.accepted_descriptors: Once accepted all its words were committed; never withdraw it because of later loader_fault. Existing transport abort preserves already offered commands and drains accepted responses.
descriptor_gate.unready: Do not offer an uncommitted read to the merger/fabric; other producer writes and engine output writes can continue.
descriptor_gate.monotonicity: Do not reset watermark or alter source/output identity while an old descriptor or bus command remains outstanding. Reset all task epochs only after joint drain.

measurement.primary_start: First producer source-write offer in an empty epoch; includes initial producer backpressure and all subsequent loading, arbitration, core, codec and final drain.
measurement.end: Actual engine-originating successful completion-magic write response handshake; not SRAM acceptance, encoder last or core done.
measurement.additional_exact_counts: I producer writes + I source reads + (O_unique+1) output writes; initial invalidation accounts for +1. Check equality at source, merge, official fabric, shared slave and response owners.
measurement.cpu_and_platform_overhead: Excluded from this conditional two-model-master fixture. Must be added or measured in actual approved loader + E203 integration; never reuse this result as official throughput.

required_tests: Both frozen prefetch8 and task9 with identical input packets and source/RTL hashes, compare real full windows.
Representative original corpus sample0, sample9 generated silence, sample202 high traffic; at least first-layer smoke then all12 layers if stable.
Serial loader comparison: all I words ACKed before START, same real bus and producer rules; streaming comparison: START at202-word ACK boundary.
Originating loader response delayed after physical SRAM write: watermark must not move early and no dependent descriptor may pass.
Long pauses at201/202-word and each X/W last-word ACK boundary; producer must continue despite a blocked descriptor; no read goes beyond committed prefix.
Random source offers, command/response backpressure, simultaneous pop/push in merge FIFO, same-edge producer ACK and gated-descriptor availability.
Loader error before START, after START while gate waits, with engine output held, and with commands already offered/accepted; no new successful final marker and both ports drain before restart.
Future source word speculatively read then producer writes it: stale read-ahead data must be invalidated; compare every engine source response with immutable original packet.
Sequential distinct tasks without global reset, fresh producer/consumer epochs, different lengths; entire shared guard and unused output slots preserved.
Hard reset with loader/engine commands pending is tested only as coordinated bus-domain reset; soft abort never cancels external offered/accepted work.
open_items: Actual organizer loader master interface, supported outstanding count, ordering, byte-mask contract and source rate are not in inspected local assets.
Whether initial loader and E203 can execute concurrently must be proven using the actual supplied platform.
If the same CPU supplies input stores, it must finish/advance production before issuing blocking WAIT; START then WAIT with incomplete input can deadlock logically.
Unknown producer clock domain: current conditional fixture is same-clock; a real CDC handshake must transfer committed metadata atomically if clocks differ.
150MHz STA, incremental area<=0.5mm2 and whole-window energy<=6.3uJ are not established.
